stories.title: 千年丽州浙江永康如何“盘活”乡村历史？

en.title: How does thousand-year-old Lizhou Yongkang in Zhejiang revitalize rural history?
en.summary: Yongkang in Zhejiang province, known for its hardware industry, is gaining attention for preserving its rural cultural heritage including ancestral hall plaques, carved buildings, and intangible cultural traditions.

stories.title: 供需双向奔赴释放消费动能

en.title: Supply and demand convergence releases consumer momentum
en.summary: China's consumer market is evolving as internal demand and consumption promotion policies take effect, with merchandise sales upgrading, service consumption expanding, and consumer expectations shifting toward quality improvements.

stories.title: 国庆“热血”特写：探访大运河畔的“最美献血点”

en.title: National Day feature: visiting the "most beautiful blood donation point" on the Grand Canal
en.summary: A blood donation facility operated by Zhejiang's blood center has opened near the Grand Canal in Hangzhou, combining modern services with the historic surroundings of the canal and traditional architecture.

stories.title: 国庆假期 各地游客打卡河北博物院感受传统文化

en.title: During National Day holiday, visitors from various places check in at Hebei Museum to experience traditional culture
en.summary: The Hebei Museum in Shijiazhuang attracted many visitors during the National Day holiday to view exhibits on stone cave art, ancient ceramics, Northern Dynasty paintings, and Warring States artifacts using digital technology and traditional displays.

stories.title: 陕西延安：苹果迎丰收 黄土高原果香浓

en.title: Shaanxi Yan'an: Apple harvest flourishes, Loess Plateau fragrant with fruit
en.summary: Apple orchards across Luochuan County in Yan'an, Shaanxi are experiencing a bountiful harvest. The county's 530,000 acres of apple cultivation have become a key rural revitalization industry through quality development initiatives.

stories.title: 电影《给阿嬷的情书》带火广东汕头百年侨宅

en.title: Film 'Love Letter to Grandma' boosts century-old overseas Chinese residence in Shantou, Guangdong
en.summary: A hundred-year-old mansion in Shantou's Chenghai District has attracted visitors following its appearance in the film 'Love Letter to Grandma'. The structure, a city-level protected heritage site, features blended Chinese-Western architecture with Southeast Asian design elements.

stories.title: ‘Cancer saved me’: Hong Kong survivor finds new purpose ahead of canoe challenge

en.title: 'Cancer saved me': Hong Kong survivor finds new purpose ahead of canoe challenge
en.summary: A 75-year-old Hong Kong man who survived stage four liver cancer 31 years ago credits the illness with transforming his lifestyle and teaching him valuable lessons about health and ageing.

stories.title: 云南耿马：国庆邂逅新米节 稻浪欢歌看“芒见”

en.title: Yunnan Gengma: National Day meets new rice festival, rice waves celebrate 'Mang encounter'
en.summary: Gengma in Yunnan's Lincang city is celebrating a new rice festival during National Day holidays, combining agricultural harvest traditions with local cultural festivities.

stories.title: US, China botanists sign landmark proposal on cooperation, global issues and projects

en.title: US, China botanists sign landmark proposal on cooperation, global issues and projects
en.summary: The botanical societies of the United States and China have signed a cooperation initiative to strengthen scientific ties and address global challenges. The agreement was formalized at a Sino-American botany conference in Shandong province that brought together hundreds of experts from both countries.

stories.title: 7万只小笼包、4万个烧饼……一组数据感受各地“一口鲜”里的烟火味

en.title: 70,000 xiaolongbao, 40,000 flatbreads... data shows local delicacies reflect holiday season vibrancy
en.summary: Regional specialty foods across China experienced peak consumption during the recent holiday period. Local culinary traditions, from steamed dumplings to baked breads, reflect the enthusiasm of Chinese consumers celebrating leisure time and enjoying quality of life.

stories.title: Chinese woman, 60, gives birth to second child in 2 years, sparking debate

en.title: Chinese woman, 60, gives birth to second child in 2 years, sparking debate
en.summary: A 60-year-old woman in central China gave birth to a daughter via caesarean section, her second child in two years. She decided to have children later in life following the death of her only child four years earlier.

stories.title: 泰国蛇鳗首次“飞”抵四川成都餐桌

en.title: Thai conger eel arrives in Chengdu, Sichuan for the first time by air
en.summary: Approximately 340 kilograms of Thai conger eel were flown to Chengdu's airport and cleared customs, marking the first import shipment of this product to Sichuan province. The seafood arrived via commercial flight and passed customs inspection.

stories.title: Wuhan joins major Chinese cities in shift towards completed-home sales

en.title: Wuhan joins major Chinese cities in shift towards completed-home sales
en.summary: Wuhan has become the fourth major Chinese city after Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou to shift towards completed-home sales. Property analysts expect this supply-side transformation to reshape China's housing market structure rather than immediately boost homebuyer demand.

stories.title: More Chinese banks likely to adopt AI rules after Ping An move: analysts

en.title: More Chinese banks likely to adopt AI rules after Ping An move: analysts
en.summary: Ping An Bank became the first listed Chinese bank to formally adopt artificial intelligence governance rules, with analysts predicting other mainland financial institutions will follow suit as regulators push for stronger AI oversight in the sector.

stories.title: McDonald’s sells Hong Kong shop for US$15.3 million as ‘old money’ returns to retail

en.title: McDonald's sells Hong Kong shop for US$15.3 million as 'old money' returns to retail
en.summary: McDonald's has sold a Hong Kong property housing its first New Territories restaurant for HK$120 million to Keen Charm Holdings, continuing its year-long divestment of self-owned locations as traditional wealth re-enters the retail property market.

stories.title: Clara Chan retains helm at HKIC as HK$62b state fund aligns with city’s 5-year plan

en.title: Clara Chan retains helm at HKIC as HK$62b state fund aligns with city's 5-year plan
en.summary: Hong Kong Investment Corporation's CEO Clara Chan has been reappointed for three additional years through October 2029, as the government-backed fund managing HK$62 billion supports emerging industries aligned with the city's five-year development strategy.

stories.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin

en.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin
en.summary: Ten developers submitted bids for Hong Kong's sole residential site in the latest government land sale programme before Friday's deadline. Major firms including Chinachem Group, Wheelock Properties, Kerry Properties and Sun Hung Kai Properties competed for the Fat Kwong Street site in Ho Man Tin.
